description: Gladstone Tsunami Animations is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Four animations of earthquake tsunami scenarios as they propagate towards the Gladstone region. Two animations depict historic tsunamis: the Solomon Islands 2007 and the Kamchatka 2025 events. Another two animations depict large hypothetical scenarios from Geoscience Australia's PTHA18 database: a magnitude 9. 0 from near the Solomon Islands and a magnitude 9. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Natural Hazards, Published_External, animation, hazard, tsunami. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-01-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
